prompts.text: Global Setting: A dark, dimly lit rocky cave environment with a mysterious and awe-inspiring atmosphere. A rugged stone crevice featuring a glowing, mystical depiction of a comet on its ceiling. 2D anime style featuring dramatic lighting, lens flares, and highly expressive, detailed character animation. [character1] [character1] is A young man with dark messy hair, wearing a dark jacket, holding a smartphone. Global Action/Motion: [character1] he slips backward down the rocky slope, flailing his arms, then stares wide-eyed in profound shock, raising both hands towards the glowing comet mural on the cave ceiling above. Floating dust particles and water droplets catch the light as they drift through the air. All shots match on [action cut], resulting action/motion continuous and spatio-temporal coherent. Shot1 is a medium close-up focused on [character1]'s face. It uses normal-standard lensing, low-angle left-three-quarter-front-view camera angle, direct-view single-subject framing, and shallow depth of field. The camera uses locked-off tripod stability.
